title: The Trump Effect In The Days Of These Kings

sense.text:
“And the house of Jacob shall be a fire”: the house of Jacob is the twelve tribes of Israel. “And the house of Joseph a flame”: Joseph stands for the rest of Israel. So it is both kingdoms, Judah and the northern kingdom, and that is important to note in these days of the Trump effect. The two kingdoms should have been united, but we have been playing games, twerking and doing all kinds of evil, so the Most High turned the heat up a little more. We are the frogs that have been boiling in America for the longest, slowly boiled into an oblivion where we cannot even think. Trump only turned the fire up to the temperature we have always been feeling, and now all of a sudden we are pointing at him. Our unity was always important, but now it is more important, because the Most High is showing us: get your act together before I really start bringing the hammers down.

“And the house of Esau for stubble”: the house of Esau for being burnt up. That is what God created them for. “And they shall kindle in them, and devour them”: the Israelites shall burn them up completely, devour them, make sure they are burnt up good. “And there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the Lord hath spoken it”: the Lord God who created him to be destroyed has spoken it, so there is no getting out of it at all. And they know this.

This is why Esau is pragmatic and a sociopath in his murderous spree and the way he operates. Pragmatic means dealing with things sensibly and realistically, on what is practical rather than theoretical or humanitarian considerations; hard-hearted, businesslike, undeterred. Coupled with a sociopathic spirit, no emotions at all, they will wipe out whole families and whole villages and think nothing of it. Their thinking is: if we don’t do this we will not survive; if God hates me, what do I have left? I have to do these things, and I have to trick you into thinking I am your friend.

Every step of progress for him is another minute of survival on the clock. His days are numbered; yours are not. That is a huge difference, and that is why they will never love you. If that is their imminent demise, what are they going to do? Fight back, with no empathy and no conscience towards you, because every second is ticking away in the hourglass for them. That ain’t your fate, that’s their fate.

So the Trump effect is not Trump himself. It is the attitude and spirit, the arrogance, of these pragmatic and sociopathic people, and how they execute their own survival against the judgment of God who is going to wipe them out. Biden, Bush, Reagan, Obama, all of them work for the same Satan; Trump is just putting it in your face, and the media is letting you see it now. More damage was done to us under the other presidents. Don’t go to sleep on him, because he is out here to burn you, but we have been getting burnt the whole time.

precepts.why:
“Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?” This is why there is no problem with Esau being Esau: the Most High made him that way. This is not hate speech, it is the truth. Why does he yet find fault? Because the Lord is still going to destroy him for what he did, though the Lord made him that way. And Esau knows that he is on borrowed time, that he does not have everlasting life.

So Esau talks like this: you have the promise of everlasting life as long as you don’t listen to me, because if you listen to me I can cause you to die with me. I don’t have that, so I have to create havoc and hell and destruction, live it up, get all the evil out of my bones now. The same God that designed me to be evil, designed me to be Satan, is going to punish me and destroy me after I do it. Knowing that, what are you trying to make sense out of it for? Leave that snake alone. Don’t call it a pretty snake, and don’t try to make amends or reconcile with this beast; you don’t understand what you are dealing with.

“For who hath resisted his will?” Who can resist the will of God? If God made him that way, how could he be anything but what God made him? The argument, Lord, if you made them the wicked, how can you be mad at them, was put in there for our simple people today. And the answer: “Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God?” In other words, negro, shut the hell up. You are a worm compared to me; I made him that way, so you better stay out of his way.

“Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?” The Most High is explaining the relationship between himself and the things he created. He made one vessel to move his bowels in and another vessel to drink wine out of. What could the toilet say to the man that made it a toilet? What else could it do but flush? What else could a snake do but bite you, when it was made to do that? People say it sounds racist, but that is the point: there is nothing to do about what God made except understand it and move in the way God made you. The problem is that we are not doing what the Lord made us to be.

Some say Romans 9:13 does not mean hate when it comes to Esau. But when we were lynched on trees, dragged here on slave ships and our women raped every day, that was hate. The massacre in Tulsa, Oklahoma, where a little boy had to find his sister with her head missing, was an act of hate, not love. That is how these people get down. And the truth of this Bible is going to become illegal: a country that stole the land, dealt in slavery and never paid us back knows this Bible brings judgment for their actions, so anyone speaking it will become public enemy number one and be called a hate group, while their prominent preachers will not deal with it the way it is written.

sense.text:
Who is fighting God? You mean to tell me God is fighting people he loves? That is what the war of Armageddon is about: these people fighting against the judgment of God to shut them down.

“Behold a great red dragon, having seven heads”: seven kings among them, Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain. The eighth head is America, which came out of the seven and shall be destroyed, as the 17th chapter shows. “And ten horns”: the common markets, NATO. “And seven crowns upon his heads”: the seven rulers. God has the whole thing laid out and they cannot get out of it.

All these people that run this system know who they are. The problem for them is that we are waking up to it, and the more of us that wake up, the faster their demise comes. That is why all this deportation is happening, moving thirty thousand Ukrainians into Chicago to get rid of the people there, trying to break the tribes up. All eyes are on this group teaching this Bible, because they say it is going to wake up the twelve tribes of Israel.

“And the great dragon was cast out”: the same red dragon, cast out of his rulership. He is worried about that right now. “That old serpent, called the Devil”: the white man is the devil. He is not white; you have never seen a white man, just as none of you are black per se. The Most High gives the color red. “And Satan”: the word devil means evil and the word Satan means adversary. He is the adversary of God, and the devil is the vessel that brings evil into the earth. Evils were multiplied when these people started ruling, and that is in their history books.

“Which deceiveth the whole world”: he deceived the whole planet with lies, with his main media, ABC, CBS. People have been put to sleep into thinking Trump the man is the only one with 666 in the back of his head, like the little Omen child, and everybody else is good fellas. Obama deported more people than Trump, but nobody knew, because the cameras were never brought in; now they bring the cameras to the workplace and put Ephraim in cuffs. Affirmative action was never about putting unqualified people in positions; our people were denied with the qualifications because of their color. Yet the narrative of DEI hires is being bought, while Biden’s crime bill destroyed many of the black fathers. They can hide things right in your face if your mind is not tuned to it. A better example of deceiving still is saying that Christ is white: no Bible on the planet gives a Caucasian image of Jesus.

“He was cast out into the earth”: meaning captivity in the earth, no more rulership. It is not something that happened at the beginning of time, Satan kicked out of heaven, the way these deceiving preachers teach; that is Christian BS madness. “And his angels were cast out with him”: his angels are his messengers, his preachers, his politicians, his policy makers, his education, his political system, his wicked music, all that sends evil messages to your mind to blind you. All of it is going down with him. Knowing they are on borrowed time, they say, come, let us come together and stop those Israelites.

When this man goes down, with all his angels and ministers, then: “Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom.” So what is in the way of our salvation? Our salvation comes when these people are no longer ruling. Verse 9 is the destruction of Esau, the seven heads, the great red dragon; verse 10 is Israel rising.

That is what 2 Esdras is speaking of: Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth. When Jacob rules, he rules in the earth. It is a change of worlds, and they don’t want that.

So it is not only Trump; it is all of them, Kamala Harris and all of them, evil as hell. Trump is actually better for us than Kamala was, because he is going to force Israel to get it together. In the days of Mondale and Reagan, our people wanted Mondale’s programs and Section 8, and the Lord gave them Reagan, no more handouts, so they had to get up and organize and work. The Most High is doing that now: it is time to wake up. He needs to agitate you to make you move.

precepts.why:
“Cast out into the earth” means captivity in the earth, no more rulership, and Lamentations explains it: “Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach. Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.”

Wait a minute, what aliens? What do you mean coming on my land and asking me for papers, when you are the alien? They are going onto reservations and having the brothers and sisters run around trying to find papers that say they are legal to be here, when the land was stolen from them first. You took the whole house, told them to live in the bathroom, and now you come in the bathroom asking where their papers are.

That is the pragmatic, sociopathic mindset. A sociopath lacks empathy, disregards the feelings of others, and manipulates or harms people without remorse, for his own gain; that is exactly what they did to the natives, and how our people have been manipulated and harmed. Sociopaths pass the polygraph and flatline it, because they know how to detach themselves from the blood still in their fingernails, and the CIA seeks out people with those tendencies; such people rise to the highest levels. They have to be that way, God made them that way, to hold down the planet with all these people angry as hell.

Dr. Martin Luther King had plenty of conscience and believed that if you suffer nonviolently, your opponent will see your suffering and change his heart. That only works if your opponent has a conscience, and the United States has none. Not just Trump: everybody that sits in that seat. Biden in the Senate said it doesn’t matter that they were deprived, it doesn’t matter that they had no background, they are predators and must be taken off the street, and Hillary Clinton called them super predators. They created a hell for us, and when the hell traumatized us, they say, we don’t care, lock you up and throw away the key so we can live in comfort on stolen land.

Thirty thousand Ukrainians came in and nobody asked them for papers, while they snatch men off the job, even one in a Latinos for Trump shirt, saying they are criminals. The Dred Scott decision shows it is written into their law: a negro whose ancestors were brought here and sold as slaves is not a citizen, was not numbered among its people, and the only clauses in the Constitution touching this race treat them as persons whom it was morally lawful to deal in as articles of property and to hold as slaves. No change in public opinion can change it. The 13th Amendment never ended slavery; it continued it under another name. Trump didn’t write that. America needs slaves; the same engine needs the same fuel. Don’t get mad at it: let what this information forges in you make you unite, because we have the Lord on our side.

sense.text: “Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.” Then he called “the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans”: these were his cadre, his advisers, astrologers and counsellors, the people he could go to for information. He said, I had a dream and it broke my sleep, and I need you to tell me what it is all about.

The Chaldeans said, “tell thy servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.” But the king answered, “The thing is gone from me”, so now they are sweating bullets. He had a bad dream and could not remember it, and they had to tell him what he forgot and what it meant, or “ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.” And if they did, “ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour.”

Daniel told the king the dream he did not even remember, and its interpretation. Daniel went into the spirit of the Lord, and when he brought it out, the king began to remember elements of the dream, and that confirmed what Daniel had shown him. When you forget something you don’t remember it until certain elements are brought up; at the beginning nobody knew anything. The power of God was working with him.

“This is the dream.” “Thou, O king, art a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory”: what Daniel saw in the dream is that Nebuchadnezzar was a man of power, made “ruler over them all.” “Thou art this head of gold”: Babylon.

“After thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee”: a kingdom less than you, which was Persia. Then the “third kingdom of brass”, Greece, and “the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron”: Rome. Babylon, Persia, Greece and Rome. From that last kingdom it comes on down into America, and that is the Trump effect again.

“Part of potters’ clay, and part of iron”: we are in this part, at the bottom. The feet are America and the European Union, 1776 to the present; that is why the Constitution was read. “They shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another.” The Most High is not going to allow Hands Across America; it is not going to happen. The Most High put Trump there, but Trump is no different from the rest of them.

“And in the days of these kings”: the kings read in this chapter, the image and its description, and at that last one the Most High is going to set up the Israelites. That is what the paranoia is about, what all the Draconian laws and the TikTok ban are about, what the Trump effect is about. Trump’s effect goes through all of those kingdoms, but primarily the last kingdom, America, from 1776 all the way up: all their presidents fit it.

“Which shall never be destroyed”: because after Esau falls, Jacob is going to rule. “And the kingdom shall not be left to other people”: nobody else is going to enjoy the kingdom of heaven but the Israelites; to them pertaineth the adoption and the glory. “But it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms”: the Most High will use Israel as his threshing instrument, his battle axe and weapons of war, to tear this whole system down when he gives us the power. “And it shall stand for ever.”

“the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold.” Daniel is telling Nebuchadnezzar, I am showing you the dream you forgot: “the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.” I have no doubt, because the Most High told me what was in your mind.

precepts.why:
The Most High put Trump there, and Trump is no different from the rest, because “The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.” He turns the minds of the kings to do what he wants done. So your elections don’t mean anything: everybody does what the Most High wants done.

It is what was read in Romans 9: who can go against God’s will? God made you to be what he made you to be, and you are going to do it. How do you think the word of God comes to pass? How could the Bible be a book of prophecies, this kingdom ruling and then the next and the next, if people had their own will? Your mind is in the mind of the Most High, period.

sense.text:
“I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd.” The Most High wanted to persuade King Ahab to go and fall at Ramoth-gilead: he was going to deceive him into thinking he would win the war, and the Most High was going to have him put to death. The point is that the Most High controls what people do.

“Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?” Ahab wanted to hear lies, that he was going to win. Micaiah kept telling him the truth, but he wanted somebody to say something smooth to him.

“Hear thou therefore the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.” Remember, the king’s heart is in the Most High’s hands: Trump, the elections, all of it is right here. On his right hand the righteous angels, on his left the wicked angels, and all of that is the Most High’s counsel.

In the book of Job the sons of God were having a conversation and Satan came among them, and the Lord asked him where he had come from; so what is all this about kicking Satan out of heaven? Satan said the Lord had a hedge around Job. That lets you know the Most High is over everything, including us Israelites: nothing can happen to us that the Most High doesn’t let happen. Even if they kill us in the body, we die in Christ and come back; when they go off the scene they wake up in captivity. Nothing is worse than going through all this affliction and then dying with your enemy.

“And the Lord said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead?” The Lord is looking at his host of heaven, the righteous angels on one side and the wicked angels on the other that he is in control of. It is a council: who is going to do it? “And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner”: volunteers, and the Lord said, that ain’t good enough.

“And there came forth a spirit”: the evil one came up from the evil side, “and stood before the Lord, and said, I will persuade him.” “Wherewith?” Let me hear what you are going to do. “I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.” That might work; that is better than the other two. “Go forth, and do so.”

So what in the world is Trump going to do, what are any of these kings going to do, when the Most High controls the whole zone? They cannot get out of this. You are worried about him doing this and that, but the Most High is going to make him fulfill what is in this Bible, and they know it.

precepts.why:
The Lord looks at both sides of his host, because “I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the Lord do all these things.” I is God, in very plain English. God forms the light and God creates darkness; God makes peace and God creates evil; the Lord sanctions who does what.

So he tells the righteous angels, go bless him because he obeyed me, and he sends the wicked angels to go jack him up, or jack her up, because they are disobedient. That is the council of 1 Kings 22: the evil spirit that volunteered was sent by the Lord.

“He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.” Wrath and indignation come from God, and trouble, by sending evil angels among those that deserve it. God does that.

That is why, in the council over Ahab, the spirit that went forth to be a lying spirit came from the wicked side of the host the Lord controls.

sense.text:
“In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full”: the Most High has had enough of them, and had enough of his people going many days without a king, as Hosea says; all that is coming up now.

“A king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.” This is talking about Esau. People look at “a king of fierce countenance” and boil it down to Trump. That is BS: the king here is America, the whole thing, and all of them speak the same language. They understand dark sentences: they know how to manipulate people’s minds through their psychological experiments on college campuses, B. F. Skinner, Stanley Milgram, the Stanford prison experiment, learning how people think, what they like and don’t like, so they can frame people’s minds to like this candidate and be against that one. Everybody is pointing at Trump as the boogeyman when the boogeyman has been all around us; the mystery of iniquity is already at work.

Esau knows he is on borrowed time. Alexander, who set up Alexandria, gathered the books of all the nations so he could know everybody’s weakness and strength: to maximize your little bit of time you have to know it all and love nobody. That is the pragmatic, sociopathic thinking. Josephus records that when the book of Daniel was shown to Alexander, declaring that one of the Greeks should destroy the empire of the Persians, he supposed himself to be the person intended and was glad. That is the pride: that’s me, I know what my job is, I am going to make it all happen. With that kind of determination, you are not stopping that.

“Shew me thy servant the interpretation and plain difference of this fearful vision”: this eagle kept showing up to the prophet. “For thou hast judged me worthy to shew me the last times”: the Lord judged Ezra worthy to be shown the latter times. “This is the interpretation of the vision.”

“The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel”: the image that was shown, the statue. “But it was not expounded unto him.” The Most High showed Daniel the ram, the goat, the leopard and the lion, but never the actual eagle. The white man tries to throw you off, putting an alligator or a dinosaur at the bottom and saying that is America. They get away with it in Christianity because they don’t read, but the Israelites know what this Bible is talking about. America is the eagle. “Therefore now I declare it unto thee.”

“Behold, the days will come, that there shall rise up a kingdom upon earth, and it shall be feared above all the kingdoms that were before it.” It is crystal clear that this is talking about America, and it is in the Bible.

Now you understand why these people are paranoid with fear about us gaining a real foothold on social media, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, all of it. With the way this Bible is being taught, people are going to find out who the wicked are that the Bible is talking about, and they will lose those they control, when their whole objective is to manipulate and make us serve them with the little bit of time they have left. That is the fight; that is the war. They gave us the illusion of freedom, public access, YouTube, social media, and then brought Draconian laws, community guidelines and the TikTok ban, because the slaves are getting loose and might find out they are Israel.

precepts.why:
Before the eagle is named, Obadiah: “Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”: concerning Esau, Edom, the so-called white man. They know this. “Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.” “Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen”: all the nations know that he is a thief. They are going to be mad at him, and that is why they are coming over here; many of those brought in will turn into caterpillars and destroy this whole system.

“Thou art greatly despised”: the people had to leave their lands to come over here because America went over there and robbed them. “The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”: Esau, Edom. “Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock”: what are they called? Caucasians. Who dwelt in the caves and the cliffs? Dwell means to live there. You cannot read this and not know it is talking about the white man.

“Whose habitation is high”: who has higher buildings than the white man? “That saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” Who else can make that statement but him? Look at Trump: Trump is indicative of the whole American system, bringing us here as slaves and still talking crap, saying who is going to make me pay, I shall see no sorrow.

“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle”: that is the point. The eagle is on their quarters, on the mail trucks, in the courts, on the flags; it is their bird. This is what Ezra was seeing. “And though thou set thy nest among the stars”: who else is doing space travel? The white man. They tried to put some of us in space, and when the Challenger went up in 1986 with so-called minorities on it, it blew up on the television in the classroom; they are doing space travel, and there ain’t no negro up there. “Thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord”: at that time he will bring you down, and that is the time period we are in now, which is what Revelation 17 goes into.

sense.text: “The judgment of the great whore”: she is the same eagle that Ezra was seeing, the same latter kingdom written in Daniel, the king understanding dark sentences. It is all the same beast, America. That is the Trump effect in the days of these kings. “That sitteth upon many waters”: ruling all over the planet.

“With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication”: foreign policy, embargoes and sanctions make them dance and get in bed with America; if you don’t dance with us, you ain’t selling nothing. “And the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication”: drunk with America’s philosophies, Christianity and the homosexual agenda that they make the other nations take up.

“A scarlet coloured beast”: wealthy. “Full of names of blasphemy”: everybody else’s wealth. “Having seven heads and ten horns”: the Greeks, Romans, Spanish, French, Germans, Russians and the British, and out of Britain came America.

“Decked with gold and precious stones and pearls”: because she stole them; she robbed the people’s resources around the earth. “Having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations”: lesbians, homosexuals, lying on the Bible and lying about God’s people, calling so-called white people Jews. It is an abomination to call you a negro or a Hispanic or anything outside of what God named you.

“MYSTERY”: nobody knows; people are confused, asking where Babylon the Great is, and preachers point to Iraq. “THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS”: America is the mother of harlots, selling herself out to all the nations. “AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH”: lesbians, homosexuals and all that are here; this is lesbian paradise and homosexual heaven, and we are in it.
“Drunken with the blood of the saints”: they murdered the Israelites, they murdered Gad. “When I saw her, I wondered with great admiration”: John wondering at the terribleness of this beast.

“Wherefore didst thou marvel?” Why are you marveling, John? Just as I showed your brother the eagle, I am about to show you. “I will tell thee the mystery of the woman”: Babylon the Great, which everybody seems not to know; you are in Babylon the Great now. “And of the beast that carrieth her”: all the red nations, the Greeks, French, Spanish, Russians, British. They all carry America; they are her porter.

“The beast that thou sawest was, and is not”: it was in your vision, John, but it is not in your time yet, because it does not physically exist. America came up only a few hundred years ago; the rest of these kingdoms existed under different names back then. “And shall ascend out of the bottomless pit”: out of Europe, out of Great Britain. “And go into perdition”: into fire and destruction. It is only here a little while, and then it is destroyed, because we are going to wake up and the Most High is going to bring devastation on his system.

“Whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world”: America was not written as an actual place in the Bible back then, because it did not exist physically, from the lineup of the nations. Yet Gad was here even at that time, in John’s day on the island. “When they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is”: when the people actually find out what this beast really is; it is coming, meaning America. These astrologers and stargazers know that what we just read is factual and the interpretation sure, and it is scaring them to death.

“Here is the mind which hath wisdom”: the mind that studies. “The seven heads are seven mountains”: the Greeks, Romans, Spanish, French, Germans, Russians and Britain. “On which the woman sitteth”: the woman is America, Babylon the Great, because that is who she gets her support from.

“Five are fallen”: all of them except Rome. “And one is”: Rome, the one John was in. “And the other is not yet come”: Britain. “And when he cometh, he must continue a short space”: America broke off from Britain and set up America; that is Britain’s short space.

“And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth”: America. “And is of the seven”: this is history; America came out of Britain. “And goeth into perdition”: it shall be destroyed by fire, and that is the time period we are in now.
